item.title: Louisiana country singer John Foster to perform in Baton Rouge this September
item.description: Louisiana native country singer John Foster will be performing at Baton Rouge live music venue The Texas Club in the fall.

item.title: Louisiana senators seek transparency on Risk Rating 2.0 as flood insurance premiums rise
item.description: Sens. John Kennedy and Bill Cassidy urge the Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) to stop Risk Rating 2.0 while seeking transparency into how flood insurance rates are set.

item.title: Saints great Demario Davis talks players who impress, Super Bowl prediction
item.description: Decorated NFL linebacker Demario Davis – who knows a thing or two about defense – sat down with Nexstar Tuesday to talk about the players who have caught his eye and what he thinks are the keys to winning Super Bowl LX.

item.title: How historic Shiloh Missionary Baptist Church tells Baton Rouge's Black History
item.description: As Baton Rouge reflects on Black History, a light shines on Shiloh Missionary Baptist Church, which has been viewed as a spiritual and cultural anchor in the city.

item.title: Trial starts for mom accused in 2021 death of 2-year-old daughter
item.description: Jury selection is concluding in the trial of Lanaya Cardwell, who faces charges in the 2021 death of her 2-year-old daughter.

item.title: Baker City Court offers amnesty for outstanding bench warrants in February
item.description: For the entire month of February, people with outstanding bench warrants in Baker City Court have an opportunity to clear them. Court officials said the goal is to help individuals resolve cases early in the year and avoid future legal trouble.
